duplicate_row_id_explained._verdict: NOT a double write: every (representation, locator, task, replicate, reader) tuple is distinct. BOTH error classes have ONE cause -- row_id and cell_id are both derived from memory_id, which is a CONTENT hash, and two source segments share one Gemma memory text (see writer_collapsed_distinct_segments). So one collapsed memory produces a duplicate row_id AND a cell that appears to repeat its replicates. The rows are real and separate.
duplicate_row_id_explained._does_not_affect_any_number: the analysis joins on (memory_unit_locator, future_task_id), which is positional. Verified: the matched summary set is 274, not 272.
